scripts.text:
[Riss]
Hello?
I found some beautiful places
while I travelled all over the world.
I am an adventurer.
Haha~
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
你好？
我在环游世界的旅途中，
发现了一些美丽的地方。
我是一名冒险者。
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Riss]
What? My name is...
'Bossnia Staff'?? No no...
Well, my name is not so important.
Sometimes you should be generous.
No time for considering that kind of small stuff
when you have to concentrate on more important things.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
什么？我的名字是...
“波士尼亚职员”？？不不不...
好吧，名字其实没那么重要。
有时候你应该大度一点。
当你需要专注于更重要的事情时，
就没时间纠结这种小事了。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Hum... anyway I want to say... something..
While I was travelling through some places,
I found a really fearful place.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
嗯...不管怎样，我想说...
在我游历某些地方的时候，
我发现了一个非常可怕的地方。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Most of the time when you come to a place,
there is one strong and fearful monster.
Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
大多数时候，当你来到一个地方，
那里都会有一只强大而可怕的魔物。
不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Riss]
But... but... in there...
There are lots of fearful and strong monsters in there...
That was really frightful.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
但是...但是...在那里...
那里有很多强大而可怕的魔物...
那真的非常恐怖。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
If I had reacted a bit later... a few seconds...
I might have been killed.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
如果我反应稍微慢一点...哪怕几秒钟...
我可能就已经死了。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
What?
You want to go in there?
Oh~ Boy~ you didn't get me.
In there.......
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
什么？
你想去那里？
哦~男孩~你还没明白我的意思。
在那里.......

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Uh... you already know?
Although you know the place, you want to go in...
Good, I will send you there.
But after you went there, don't hold
a grudge against me. It'll cost you 1 Reset Stone for 5 access.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
呃...你已经知道了？
虽然你知道那个地方，但还是想去...
好吧，我会送你去那里。
但去了之后，可别怪我。
需要1个重置石，可以使用5次。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Uh... you already know?
Although you know the place, you want to go in...
Good, I will send you there.
But after you went there, don't hold
a grudge against me. Also it costs 5,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
呃...你已经知道了？
虽然你知道那个地方，但还是想去...
好吧，我会送你去那里。
但去了之后，可别怪我。
另外需要5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
You don't have a ticket now.....
So come to me again with a Reset Stone later.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
你现在没有门票了.....
所以请之后带着重置石再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Would you really like to take the challenge?
Ok, just choose the course.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
你真的想接受挑战吗？
好的，那就选择赛道吧。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
Take care, boy~
Don't hold a grudge against me.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
加油哦，男孩~
可别对我怀恨在心啊。

scripts.text:
[Riss]
You don't have enough money...
Come back when you have at least 5,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[里斯]
你的Zeny不够...
至少要有5,000 Zeny再来吧。
